title: Обслуживание - прикладные показатели
description: Текущее состояние неудалённых заявок за всё время. Время закрытия рассчитывается для статуса done

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.status AS "Статус", COUNT(r.id)::integer AS "Заявок" FROM (VALUES ('new', 1), ('in_progress', 2), ('done', 3), ('rejected', 4)) AS s(status, position) LEFT JOIN public.maintenance_requests r ON r.status = s.status AND r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.status, s.position ORDER BY s.position

SELECT p.priority AS "Приоритет", COUNT(r.id)::integer AS "Заявок" FROM (VALUES ('low', 1), ('medium', 2), ('high', 3), ('critical', 4)) AS p(priority, position) LEFT JOIN public.maintenance_requests r ON r.priority = p.priority AND r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.priority, p.position ORDER BY p.position

panels.title: Среднее время закрытия, часы
panels.description: От создания до последнего перехода в done. Отклонённые заявки не учитываются

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closure.closed_at - r.created_at)) / 3600.0)::double precision AS "Часы" FROM public.maintenance_requests r JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(h.changed_at) AS closed_at FROM public.request_status_history h WHERE h.request_id = r.id AND h.new_status = 'done') closure ON TRUE WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'done'

panels.title: Просроченные плановые работы
panels.description: Плановая дата прошла, статус new или in_progress.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS "Заявок" FROM public.maintenance_requests WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('new', 'in_progress') AND planned_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

panels.title: Нагрузка на оборудование
panels.description: Неудалённое оборудование; все неудалённые заявки и сумма назначенных часов

targets.rawSql: WITH assigned_hours AS (SELECT request_id, SUM(hours) AS hours FROM public.request_assignees GROUP BY request_id) SELECT e.name AS "Оборудование", e.serial_number AS "Серийный номер", COUNT(r.id)::integer AS "Заявок", COALESCE(SUM(a.hours), 0)::double precision AS "Плановые часы" FROM public.equipment e LEFT JOIN public.maintenance_requests r ON r.equipment_id = e.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN assigned_hours a ON a.request_id = r.id WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.serial_number ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC, e.serial_number
